entities.name: Sleeper agent
entities.description: Phyrexian organism planted on a foreign plane, inactive for a long time while establishing a secure position.

entities.name: Newts
entities.description: Expendable first-generation sleeper agents grown from harvested flesh.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: Praetor punished after the failed first sleeper agent deployment.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: Best-known first-generation sleeper agent, who betrayed Phyrexia and befriended Urza.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Friend of Xantcha, nearly killed by Kerrick.

entities.name: Kerrick
entities.description: Second-generation sleeper agent who infiltrated the Tolaria academy.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: Created New Phyrexia's compleated sleeper agents.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: Phyrexian realm that employed many sleeper agents.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: Empire whose emperor was assassinated and cities ruined by sleeper agents.

entities.name: Stenn
entities.description: Benalish nobleman converted into a sleeper agent.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Planeswalker captured and turned into a sleeper agent.

entities.name: Karn's sylex
entities.description: Artifact whose touch revealed Ajani's compleation.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which many sleeper agents were employed.

events.summary: Roughly a thousand first-generation newts are sent out after the Brothers' War but are slain by defenders; Gix is punished.
events.quote: The praetor Gix was harshly punished for this oversight

events.summary: Kerrick infiltrates the Tolaria academy and almost kills Urza.
events.quote: who infiltrated the academy on Tolaria and almost managed to kill Urza

events.summary: New Phyrexia uses sleeper agents in the invasion, assassinating the emperor and ruining Sun Empire cities.
events.quote: assassinating the emperor and causing ruin to many of the Sun Empire 's cities

events.summary: Stenn learns of his true identity after finding the false location of Karn's sylex.
events.quote: Stenn himself was unaware of his true identity

events.summary: Ajani is captured, turned into a sleeper agent and released; his compleation is revealed when he touches Karn's sylex.
events.quote: Ajani Goldmane was captured and turned into a Sleeper Agent

relations.quote: betrayed Phyrexia and became a friend of Urza 's
